title: Display Name Fallback
prompt: A TypeScript profile card can receive first and last names, but some accounts only have a username. Write a function that returns "first last" when both names exist, otherwise returns the username.

explanation.beginner: Start by identifying what the function receives and what it must return. For Display Name Fallback, read the story as a simple input-to-output rule: A TypeScript profile card can receive first and last names, but some accounts only have a username. Write a function that returns "first last" when both names exist, otherwise returns the username. Work through one small example by hand, then write the steps in TypeScript using plain variables before worrying about making the code shorter.
